title: Lecture Formal Activity UI Bridge

preflight.note: Created on an isolated public worktree at exact public base 062fa286005aa9f22a87303f310515ef4beaa83f before implementation. The shared public checkout and private authored course are out of scope.

acceptance_criteria.text: Lecture formal segments resolve sourceActivityId and sourceLocation to the exact authored CourseActivity and render through the shared generic authored-activity surface.
Guided practice and independent practice complete through the authoritative CourseProgress runtime without becoming mastery gates or using a fake success path.
Assessment and remediation segments use the existing CourseProgress evaluation, remediation, retry, module-assessment, and capstone semantics.
Missing, mismatched, or invalid formal activity sources fail closed with the bounded learner-facing message This lecture activity could not be resolved. and do not mutate progress.
Lecture formal activities have no direct segment-advance bypass; informational and interactive lecture segments retain their existing behavior and completion UI.

Neutral public-safe fixtures and focused tests cover guided practice, independent practice, assessment, remediation, module assessment, capstone, source failures, direct-bypass prevention, informational/interactive regressions, and completion UI state.
Public validation gates, browser acceptance, privacy scan, and evidence packet pass on the public branch without Course Studio or private-course content changes.
The reviewed public branch is pushed for independent review and is not merged, packaged, or installed by the implementing agent before approval.

source: Lecture Formal-Activity UI Bridge Fix + Installed Acceptance Rerun request.
